label: Philippines
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across the Philippines -- Metro Manila, Cebu and Mactan, the island of Boracay, and a Batangas countryside retreat.
intro: The Philippines' coverage in this directory spans Metro Manila -- the Manila Bay waterfront, the Ortigas business district, and Newport City beside Ninoy Aquino International Airport; Metro Cebu and its Mactan island beach resorts in the central Visayas; the white-sand island of Boracay; and a countryside wellness retreat in Batangas south of the capital. The mix runs from large integrated-resort and beach hotels to compact select-service city stays.
